entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I believe that takes care of that.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, where are we now?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This room seems very different to[n]the rest of the Palace... It was more[n]heavily guarded as well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Could this be... some sort of[n]surveillance room?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The monitors are displaying various[n]rooms within the Palace.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait... We were being watched[n]this whole time?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I dunno about that...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yep! I knew it. This room's more of a[n]mainframe than a monitoring system.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: All sorts of information's being collected[n]here from across the Palace and getting[n]converted into raw data.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Data collection? But, what for?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know, this room ain't got any[n]sorta way forward. Think we gotta[n]find another path somewhere else?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Actually, it looks like there's a path beyond[n]those cables—we're sure not using it as is,[n]though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh! What is it now?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Is that... Mementos?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I've tracked the location all the data[n]is being sent to!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Looks like it's going into Mementos.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We might be able to make some headway[n]if we investigate this location.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That reminds me, Lavenza did tell us...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Dr. Maruki is utilizing Mementos to[n]distort all of reality.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even still... Are those really[n]data cables?
Let's go check Mementos.
I think we're done here for now.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Agreed. Sticking around here isn't[n]going to help us any.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Alright, let's get outta here for now.[n]Let's see if a Mementos trip does us[n]any good!
